name: Information & Referral
description: Free, friendly conversation about community resources and services for people age 60 and over, their caregivers and interested individuals, including help with long-term care choices. Transportation Concierge services are accessed through this department.
contact: (413) 586-2000; 320 Riverside Drive, Suite B, Florence, MA 01062

requirements.text: Highland Valley Elder Services lists 24 towns it serves, including Amherst: Amherst, Blandford, Chester, Chesterfield, Cummington, Easthampton, Goshen, Granville, Hadley, Hatfield, Huntington, Middlefield, Montgomery, Northampton, Pelham, Plainfield, Russell, Southampton, Southwick, Tolland, Westfield, Westhampton, Williamsburg, Worthington.
Offered to those age 60 and over, to their caregivers, and to interested individuals.

unknowns: Transportation Concierge eligibility, cost, and destinations are not described on the page.

Not every town in Hampshire County is on the agency's 24-town list (e.g. it is unclear whether Belchertown, Granby, South Hadley or Ware residents are served); residency is a town list, not a whole county.
Service area limited to ZIP codes whose postal city is a town on the HVES list; village ZIP codes (e.g. Florence, Leeds, Haydenville) may also be served but are not listed. Call to confirm.

first_step.title: Ask about the Transportation Concierge
first_step.detail: Call Highland Valley Elder Services Information & Referral at (413) 586-2000.
